newsitem.title: Philippines: Manila share index ends up near all-time high.
newsitem.headline: Manila share index ends up near all-time high.

text.p: * Value turnover heavy at 5.5 billion pesos
The Manila share index closed up on Wednesday just 2.33 points shy of the 3,375.94 all-time high which it momentarily surpassed in late trade, traders said.
"We saw across-the-board buying but it was really PLDT that was the backbone of the market's ascent," said Helen Alvarez, research head at All Asia Securities.
The main index closed up 31.62 points, or 0.95 percent, at 3,373.61.
The index reached 3,376.51 points in late trade but later fell back. Gainers beat losers 98 to 39 with 66 issues unchanged.
PLDT, one of the most actively traded stocks, closed 75 pesos, or 4.95 percent, up at 1,590 pesos. Other blue-chips which saw heavy buying were Petron Corp and Manila Electric Co B shares.

Jonas Ferrer, research head at Pryce Securities, said heavy foreign buying was evident with the market showing confidence in property issues which have been laggards such as Fil-Estate Land and Filinvest Land.

Alvarez said the market will likely sustain its run-up on Thursday with some slight profit-taking early in the session. She said movements will depend on 1996 Gross National Product (GNP) data and San Miguel Corp earnings to be announced later on Wednesday.
Better-than-expected results will mean more positioning in San Miguel, Noel Reyes, research head at Anscor-Hagedorn Securities Inc said.
